event_var.var_meaning: overall survival status (Alive/Dead); 'Dead' indicates death, 'Alive' indicates patient alive at last follow-up (censored)

notes: Time variable and unit taken from GEO sample metadata 'characteristics_ch1' fields (e.g., 'overall survival (os) (month): 34' in GSM5754372).

Contradiction between sources: STAR Methods (Samples) states 'Overall survival was defined number of days from the start of the treatment.' This conflicts with the '(month)' unit in the sample metadata; the unit is therefore ambiguous.

Observed numeric values across samples (examples up to 124) are more consistent with months as the unit; unit chosen as 'month' to reflect the metadata but users should verify original clinical records.

Event coding (Dead/Alive) is present in metadata but not formally enumerated in Methods; mapping 'Dead' = event (death) and 'Alive' = censored is inferred from common survival-analysis practice and the paper's use of log-rank/Cox models.
Time origin for OS is explicitly given in the paper Methods as 'start of the treatment' (though the Methods' stated unit—days—disagrees with the sample metadata).
